trello.name: Sign venue contract with AV recording in all three rooms
trello.desc: Diego to route the convention center contract (main hall + two breakout rooms, $18,000) through legal review and obtain signature by end of next week. Must confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall and both breakouts), not main-hall only as happened last year. Acceptance criteria: signed contract on file and written confirmation of AV recording coverage for all three rooms.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup within two weeks
trello.desc: Bo to send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, fill from the backup list of five names. Goal is to have all nine speakers confirmed (six already confirmed + three more) within two weeks so the agenda can be printed. Acceptance criteria: nine confirmed speakers, lineup locked, ready for agenda printing.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei this week
trello.desc: Bo to chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is needed for both the website and the printed program. Acceptance criteria: keynote abstract received and ready for publication.

trello.name: Draft three-wave email marketing campaign this month
trello.desc: Diego to draft all three email campaign waves this month: (1) agenda announcement to go out the day the agenda/speaker lineup goes live, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, (3) final-week push. Registration currently at 340 against a target of 600. Acceptance criteria: all three emails drafted and ready; first wave scheduled to send the day the agenda is live.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots same day lineup locks
trello.desc: Once the speaker lineup is locked, Bo to immediately (same day) hand all speaker bios and headshots to Diego for the website landing page update. Diego needs these before the first email wave goes out. Acceptance criteria: bios and headshots delivered to Diego on the same day the lineup is confirmed; speaker pages updated on website before wave one email send.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs and place order this week
trello.desc: Camille to review the swag design proofs in the shared drive today and approve. Once approved, Diego to immediately place the order: 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, 1,000 stickers (~$9,200 with rush buffer). Lead time was six weeks last year so order must be placed this week to avoid cutting it close. Acceptance criteria: proofs approved by Camille today; order placed by Diego within the same week.
